body:
# 📊 Server Stats

A lightweight **developer tool** for Paper servers that shows real-time server performance stats in one command — OP only.

---

## ✨ Features
- ⚡ **TPS & MSPT** — know if your server is lagging
- 🧠 **RAM & CPU** — monitor memory and processor usage
- 💾 **Disk** — visual progress bar showing storage usage
- 👥 **Players** — online / max
- ⏱ **Uptime** — how long the server has been running
- 🌍 **Worlds, Chunks & Entities** — loaded world data
- 🔌 **Plugins** — enabled / total
- 🧵 **Threads & GC** — JVM performance data
- 🖥 **Version & Java** — server and runtime info

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/ss` | Show server stats |
| `/ss reload` | Reload config |

---

## ⚙ Config

- Change the **command name** to anything you want
- Toggle **any stat** on or off
- Customize all **colors and messages**

---

## 📌 Setup
- Paper 1.21 — 1.21.11
- Java 21+

---
